capabilities.name: Federated multi-model hard clash detection with penetration depth
capabilities.reference_behavior: Executes spatial intersection analysis between element selection sets across disciplines. Identifies overlapping 3D bounding geometry, calculates minimum penetration overlap, and records clash records.
capabilities.expected_input: Structural column and MEP pipe overlapping in 3D space
capabilities.expected_output: 1 hard clash detected; penetration depth 0.2 m; clash point recorded
capabilities.differences: Detailed triangle-triangle polygonal mesh intersection is planned for subsequent iterations.

capabilities.name: Clearance buffer proximity violation detection
capabilities.reference_behavior: Computes Euclidean separation distance between isolated elements and flags clearance violations where distance is less than or equal to the specified buffer threshold.
capabilities.expected_input: Wall and electrical tray separated by 0.02 m with 0.05 m clearance threshold
capabilities.expected_output: 1 clearance clash detected with distance 0.02 m
capabilities.differences: Complex non-convex clearance sweeps are deferred.

capabilities.name: BIM Collaboration Format (BCF 2.1 XML) export and session persistence
capabilities.reference_behavior: Exports clash viewpoints and component identifiers to industry standard BCF XML structure and roundtrips multi-model coordination state natively.
capabilities.expected_output: Valid BCF 2.1 XML with viewpoints, origin coordinates, and components; restored session
capabilities.differences: Embedded PNG snapshot thumbnails in BCF archives are planned for GUI release.
